title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E08 — The Razor's Edge
Contestants compete with throwing knives and slingshots; in addition to the elimination challenge, another contestant suddenly goes home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E09 — The Shortest Fuse
The teams dissolve, as everyone competes for him or herself, and three people are ultimately sent home; In the first of two surprise challenges, everyone has to shoot a lit fuse sending the shortest fuse home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E10 — Season Finale
The final four contestants compete to determine the winner of the $100,000 prize.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E01 — Sharpshooter Surprise
16 competitors arrive from around the country and face a surprise right from Civil War history for an opportunity to choose teams; a team challenge of extreme billiards; an elimination challenge which sends the first two marksmen home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E02 — Shoot or Be Shot
Using prohibition era weapons, teams try to hit their targets, while being shot at with paintballs; two contestants face off with the iconic Tommy Gun.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E03 — Uphill Battle
The teams try to blow up an ammo dump, using the legendary M1A rifle; one contestant's mistakes put his team in jeopardy; marksmen face obscured targets challenge using the Glock 17 pistol.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E09 — Prohibition Pawn
A Civil War drum is brought into the shop; an 1834 book with the original rules of baseball; a customer brings in a 1970s skateboard.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S12 E07 — Promissory Pawn
Corey and Chum look at a water-propelled jetpack; a promissory note from the Mexican-American War; a statue of the Hindu god Shiva is brought into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E02 — Ace in the Hole
The team is presented with an antique professional gambler's toolkit; Rick and Corey look to buy rare pieces of 1896 U.S. currency; a man hopes to sell his 1950s radiation detecting Geiger counter.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E21 — Darth Pawn
The Pawn Stars check out a 1763 Stradivarius violin; Rick and Chumlee meet a man selling life-sized Star Wars figures; Rick and the Old Man check out the World War II airplane's version of GPS, an octant.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S16 E01 — Pawn It Out of the Park
Rick heads east to test a rare 18th-century weapon; Corey takes a swing at a Mickey Mantle rookie card; military expert Alex brews something special for Rick's eyes only.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E15 — Catch-32
Mike and Frank have their work cut out for them on a huge property with more custom 1932 Fords than they have ever seen in one place; Danielle takes on an important military mission.

title: American Pickers
description:
S19 E20 — One Wheel Deal
In Missouri, the guys visit an historic homestead where they join the search for grandpa's lost Civil War uniform.

title: American Pickers
description:

title: Grant
description:
S01 E01 — Unlikely Hero
In one of the unlikeliest stories in American history, Ulysses S. Grant rises from his humble beginnings to become the winning general in one of the Civil War's bloodiest battles.

title: Grant
description:
S01 E02 — Lincoln's General
Ulysses S. Grant takes incredible risks, becomes Abraham Lincoln's favorite general, and prepares for an epic clash with Robert E. Lee.

title: Grant
description:
S01 E03 — Freedom's Champion
Ulysses S. Grant defeats Robert E. Lee and wins the Civil War, only to find that he will be called to serve as president during one of the most difficult times in America history.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E07 — Re-Fueling a Fighter Jet; Naval Signal Flags; GI Chow
How to refuel a fighter jet in midair; how ships send messages using signal flags; what soldiers eat.
